{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for severe disease
severe_df = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline for severe patients
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline for severe patients:", severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())

# Identify rows with sentinel value -999.0
sentinel_rows = severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]
print("Number of sentinel rows:", len(sentinel_rows))
print("Sentinel rows:", sentinel_rows[['patient_id', 'biomarker_baseline']])

# Compute the mean biomarker_baseline for severe patients excluding sentinel values
mean_biomarker_severe_clean = severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

mean_biomarker_severe_clean"}
